title: audit detail notification.read
description: detail of audit rows with action notification.read: a user (or the user's agent, 11-agent-access.md section 7) marked notifications read (ADR-063 section 2): the number marked and what was marked (ids: the listed ones; all: every org notification; all_account: also the account notifications). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
